title: Filter Wheel Exposure Share by Filter
dataSources: NINA sequences (`nina:sequence`), NINA autofocus runs (`nina:autofocus`), Ekos scheduler and device events (`ekos:scheduler`, `ekos:device`), PHD2 guiding telemetry (`phd2:guide`), plate solves (`platesolve:run`), filter wheel events (`filterwheel:event`), and flat frames (`flatlib:frame`).
app: Astrophotography session telemetry from N.I.N.A., KStars/Ekos, PHD2, plate-solving tools, ASCOM gear, and filter-wheel controllers sent to Splunk HEC via logs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=filterwheel:event
| search event="exposure_open" exposure_sec=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(exposure_sec) as exposure_sec by _time filter_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks exposure time by filter over time and breaks it out by filter.
value: Filter share makes it easier to spot whether narrowband or luminance plans are drifting away from what you intended.
implementation: Send exposure time by filter events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of exposure time by filter by filter.
grandmaExplanation: It produces how exposure time by filter changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
